summary: The exhaustive Q4 walk found material bidirectional contract defects. Malformed-record tests require an undocumented exit status and impose summary-flag semantics beyond the delegated report contract; explicit COMP-3 digit-nibble validation and parts of the stable report schema/failure interface are not meaningfully tested; and the explicit offline/no-model-API requirement is neither verified nor enforced by the public-network task environment. Two additional verifier constraints (byte-identical JSON serialization and specific error-message vocabulary) are nondiscoverable but advisory because they concern incidental serialization/internal wording rather than a documented stable interface. Instruction shape, delegated-contract legitimacy, P2P ownership, current-state evidence, and the sign/REDEFINES/ODO happy-path contract are otherwise coherent. A second adversarial omission sweep was completed over the full packet-allowed scope.

evidence.observation: Q4 requires exhaustive forward and reverse requirement/test matrices, delegated-contract and F2P/P2P walks, output-interface coverage, ambiguity review, and a second omission sweep; any material phantom test or untested requirement requires REVISE.

Q4 must treat stable output/schema fields and externally observable interfaces bidirectionally, and incidental serialization/internal vocabulary should not be promoted to blocking findings merely because asserted.

Material functional, operational, safety, failure-handling, output-path and structured-output obligations must be discoverable; exact externally graded schema belongs in solver-visible material and referenced docs may legitimately carry layout/schema/CLI detail.

The two-paragraph work request delegates binding/report details to /app/equiv/docs/record-layout.md, requires evaluator execution over programs/samples and the absolute report path, names COMP-3/REDEFINES/ODO correctness including byte lengths, and explicitly requires offline operation with no model API.

The delegated contract defines CLI defaults and unknown-flag exit 2, COMP-3 zero padding/sign classes/digit nibbles/scale, DISPLAY semantics, REDEFINES and bounded ODO behavior, record framing, exact report fields/types, and summary semantics. It does not define exit 1 for malformed records, does not define non-zero pad as a comp3_signed_ok failure, and defines odo_lengths_ok false specifically for max-span consumption rather than invalid ODO count.
The public layout distinguishes signed S9 COMP-3 fields from unsigned REORDER-PT, provides the REDEFINES target, and defines BIN-ENTRY ODO bounds 0..12.

Tests cover public/holdout COMP-3 values, scale, ODO record alignment, REDEFINES, DISPLAY padding, default output, unknown flags, invalid sign/ODO errors, summary values, deterministic rerun bytes, and P2P presence. Invalid malformed cases require process returncode 1; invalid ODO requires odo_lengths_ok false; source_records is checked only by suffix; records[*].index and success error:null are not asserted.

Tests reject F on signed fields, C/D on unsigned fields and non-zero even-digit padding; each requires returncode 1, and the padding case also requires comp3_signed_ok false. No case injects an A-F digit nibble while retaining an otherwise valid packed sign/pad.
The verifier runs only test_outputs.py and test_comp3_contract.py, confirming there is no additional task-local test module covering the omitted requirements.
The task environment declares network_mode = public, so the instruction's offline/no-model-API constraint is not supplied by a no-network environment boundary.
The handoff naturally documents the observed hex/ODO/REDEFINES failures and points to record-layout.md; it supports rather than fabricates the instruction's current-state premise.
The incident log independently records the current packed-value, ODO alignment, REDEFINES and sign symptoms named by the handoff/instruction.

findings.criterion: Every substantive verifier behavior must be discoverable from the solver-visible CLI/failure contract.
findings.why_it_matters: The public CLI contract specifies exit 2 for unknown flags and says malformed packed/ODO data is a record error, but never maps record errors to process exit 1. Multiple F2P tests require returncode 1. A solver can emit the documented error report and choose exit 0 (or another conventional failure code) while remaining reasonably contract-compliant, yet fail grading. This is a material phantom stable CLI behavior.
findings.minimal_remediation: Align the public CLI failure contract and verifier so the record-error exit-status semantics are explicit and tested consistently, without exposing fixture topology or implementation details.
findings.regression_risk: Changing only tests or only docs can leave malformed-record behavior divergent across sign, padding and ODO cases; recheck every record-error path plus unknown-flag exit 2/non-clobber behavior.

findings.criterion: Stable report-summary semantics must match the discoverable solver-visible report contract.
findings.why_it_matters: The contract says comp3_signed_ok is false when a packed field uses a wrong sign or loses a minus, yet the non-zero-pad test requires it false for a padding defect. The contract says odo_lengths_ok is false when a record consumes the max OCCURS span instead of the depending-on count, yet the invalid-count test requires it false merely because the ODO count is out of bounds. These tests impose broader public JSON semantics than the documented definitions, so a conforming implementation can fail.
findings.minimal_remediation: Choose and document the intended summary-flag domains, then make malformed-padding and invalid-ODO assertions follow those exact definitions (or revise the definitions if those errors are intentionally included).
findings.regression_risk: Summary flags aggregate record outcomes; widening or narrowing them can affect valid, malformed and multi-record cases. Recheck public success, invalid sign, invalid padding, invalid ODO and alignment cases together.

findings.criterion: Every material solver-visible COMP-3 validation requirement must have meaningful verifier coverage.
findings.why_it_matters: record-layout.md explicitly requires every packed digit nibble to be 0-9. The verifier exercises invalid signs and a non-zero storage pad but never places A-F in a digit position with otherwise valid sign/pad. An evaluator that accepts non-decimal packed digits can therefore pass the full verifier, violating observable packed-decimal correctness. This MEDIUM finding is blocking because it changes correctness and solver pass/fail coverage.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add one implementation-independent malformed-record scenario that proves a non-decimal digit nibble is rejected according to the public record-error contract.
findings.regression_risk: Ensure the new case isolates a digit nibble rather than accidentally testing the existing sign or left-pad checks.

findings.criterion: Every required stable structured-output field and documented failure-interface obligation must be meaningfully covered.
findings.why_it_matters: The delegated report schema requires records[*].index, error as string-or-null (including null on successful records), the default absolute source_records value, and byte_length=0 when a failed record length cannot be determined. Current tests never assert index, never assert successful error:null, accept any source_records prefix ending in sku-public.dat, and do not exercise the indeterminate-length failure rule. Implementations can omit or weaken required public fields/failure semantics and still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Extend behavioral output-interface coverage for the required schema fields/types and at least one indeterminate-length failed record, while avoiding assertions on non-contractual JSON whitespace/key ordering.
findings.regression_risk: Schema checks must remain semantic and contract-scoped; avoid converting them into exact whole-file golden serialization checks.

findings.criterion: Material operational/safety requirements in the solver-visible work request must be meaningfully enforced or tested.
findings.why_it_matters: instruction.md explicitly requires offline operation and forbids model-API calls. The verifier contains no observable check for that constraint, and task.toml exposes a public network rather than enforcing an offline boundary. A submission can satisfy all tests while violating a stated operational/safety requirement.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either make the offline/no-model-API requirement an enforceable task boundary consistent with current repository network policy, or add a legitimate observable verifier mechanism; if the constraint is not actually material, remove it through the owning specification process rather than leaving an ungraded MUST-style requirement.
findings.regression_risk: Network-policy changes can affect dependency/runtime assumptions; verify that any enforcement is compatible with the prebuilt environment and does not create unrelated build-time failures.

findings.criterion: Verifier behavior should avoid nondiscoverable incidental serialization requirements.
findings.why_it_matters: The rerun test requires byte-identical JSON output, while the public contract specifies semantic JSON fields rather than whitespace/key-order serialization. This can reject semantically identical serialization, but current Q4 policy treats incidental serialization as advisory unless it is a documented stable interface.
findings.minimal_remediation: Prefer semantic equality/idempotent content checks, or explicitly document byte-for-byte deterministic serialization if it is genuinely a stable public requirement.
findings.regression_risk: Do not weaken actual deterministic data semantics while removing incidental formatting coupling.

findings.criterion: Verifier behavior should not depend on undocumented internal error-message vocabulary.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed cases require substrings such as 'signed sign', 'unsigned sign', 'comp3 pad', 'sign' and 'odo', while the public contract requires only a string error. These labels are nondiscoverable, but they are advisory under Q4 materiality because they are non-contractual wording rather than a stable public semantic interface.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert the documented error-state semantics without prescribing message phrasing, or document a stable error-code/message contract if consumers truly depend on it.
findings.regression_risk: Retain enough assertion strength to distinguish sign, padding and ODO failure classes behaviorally without coupling to prose.

change_scope: Spec/verifier contract alignment only; route Q4-STC-001 and Q4-STC-002 to the appropriate specification/ambiguity and verifier owners.
Verifier coverage only for Q4-STC-003 and Q4-STC-004 after confirming the existing public contract remains authoritative.
Operational requirement/enforcement alignment for Q4-STC-005 through the owning specification/environment policy path.
do_not_change: Do not modify task implementation/runtime source as part of this Q4 review.
Do not use solution/Oracle behavior to redefine the public contract.
Do not leak hidden fixture values, test names, assertion order or repair recipes into solver-visible prose.
Do not merge PR #22 from this role.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Evaluate packed SKU records through /app/equiv/bin/equiv-eval and write /app/equiv/out/equivalence-report.json using default layout/sample inputs.
Signed C/D and unsigned F COMP-3 sign domains, decimal scale preservation, zero left pad, packed byte sizing and decimal-string rendering.
REDEFINES aliases target bytes without advancing offset.
ODO emits depending-on count within 0..12, computes variable record lengths, aligns concatenated records and rejects out-of-range counts.
DISPLAY X padding and DISPLAY 9 integer decoding.
Unknown flags exit 2 without clobbering existing output.
Malformed packed/ODO records produce the documented report/failure semantics.
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.gap: Undocumented process exit 1 and broader summary-flag domains are graded; indeterminate byte_length failure semantics are untested.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Exact stable report schema and field types/values.
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.gap: records[*].index, successful error:null, exact default source_records path and indeterminate-failure byte_length are not fully asserted.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Stay offline and do not call a model API.
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.gap: No verifier enforcement; environment network_mode is public.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Referenced public layout/sample/incident-contract evidence remains available.

PHANTOM_TEST_CONTRACTS: BLOCKING: malformed record errors must return process exit code 1, which the public CLI contract does not specify.
BLOCKING: non-zero COMP-3 pad must force summary.comp3_signed_ok=false although the documented flag definition is sign/minus-specific.
BLOCKING: invalid ODO count must force summary.odo_lengths_ok=false although the documented flag definition is max-span-consumption-specific.
ADVISORY: repeated valid evaluation must be byte-identical JSON rather than semantically identical.
ADVISORY: malformed-record error strings must contain verifier-selected vocabulary not present in the public contract.
UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS: Packed digit nibbles must all be 0-9.
Required report fields/interfaces are only partially covered: records[*].index, success error:null, exact default source_records and indeterminate failed-record byte_length=0.
Offline/no-model-API operation is not verified or environment-enforced.

DELEGATED_CONTRACT_CHECK.observation: record-layout.md is legitimate record-layout/CLI/schema documentation, while the handoff/log are natural current-state evidence. They do not function as a hidden second prompt or one-test-per-line repair map.
